main_text.p: Amiculum erat vestis ex auro, hyacinthino, & purpureo & coccineo dibapho, & nativo xylino internexo, opere artificiosissimo factum.ver.6.
Humeralia sunt duo coniungentia in duabus extremitatibus, dextra & sinistra scilicet.ver.7.
Cingulum vero erat ex auro, hyacinthino purpureo,& coccineo dibapho, & natiuo xylino internexo.ver.8.

Imposita erant duo lapides Sardonychæ, opere artificiosissimo lapidarij,sculpturis tanquam sigilli insculpti: nomina duodecim filiorum prout nati sunt Israeli, ordine æquali,vtroq; lapide in se habentes.
Hi autem s Aptati sunt inter se. ʒ Exod.28.9. ita facti ʗ Tum impositi. s 10.11.12.
Fundæ aureæ erant ad quas appositæ erant in hunc finem catenæ.ver.14.
Catenæ erant æquabiles ex auro puro,opere tortili factæ.ver.14.
Impositi autem sunt humeralibus illius amiculi; vt portet Aaharon nomina eorum coram Iehouæ super duos humeros,in monumentum.ver.12.

page.notes: Marginal references in the right of the synopsis: "Exod.28.", "4.31.", "ver.7.8.9.10." Right-hand margin of the adjoining page partly visible and not transcribed. Brace and bracket structure is rendered as an outline; some wording of the brace labels is doubtful, notably "Imposita" and "dibapho" (possibly dibapho as printed). Part of the page is cut off in this image. Right-hand strip shows fragments of the facing page (texti, rat.E, tem, hyac, fimb, nebat, in ips, more, nis su, contin, spiritu, qui φ, 8.26.2); not transcribed. Catchword "Significa-" is printed at the lower right of the text; handled as catchword only.
